metadata.title: C# Programming Language — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: Machine-readable connected knowledge graph covering C# language identity, history, standards, versions, syntax, type system, object orientation, functional programming, LINQ, async/concurrency, memory, exceptions, metaprogramming, compiler/runtime architecture, libraries, tools, frameworks, implementations, and language influences.
metadata.source_basis: User-provided C# article extract (Wikipedia-style source) plus structured language-domain knowledge used to expand connections and normalize concepts.
